It does not restore9ACDD4 or source DWORD288 bit0x100.

claims.Limitations: Absence of a minimum does not remove the saved-party capacity/lifecycle gates already in the trainer.

claims.Limitations: Calling it speculatively from a trainer as a validation helper can mutate global resource placement and owner state.

fields.phase: BYTE+1;3 means completed, not typed content validated

registry_contract.lifetime: 39D590/39E690 can replace or move payloads, and39D460/39E900 can unlink/free records. Inspect a bounded complete acyclic list and fresh first match; do not retain raw pointers across yields.
registry_contract.first_match: 39E1E0 returns the first exact string/group match; group-1 accepts any group. A later valid duplicate cannot repair an earlier invalid first match.

checkpoint_contract.before_native_begin: Only currently installed table/scene/Save predicates are proven here. Cold target resources need a separate effective-reader/staging contract before player/form/party mutations.
checkpoint_contract.raw_validation: The actual raw bytes must be checked before3A0C60's3A64F0 and3A0790's3A6840. A callback39DEE0 interception is already too late.
checkpoint_contract.loaded_validation: 40D119 is an observable candidate after wait. A decisive fresh check would need the verified fiber/context after its last yield and before source cleanup starts40D222 (definitely before descriptor call40D250).
checkpoint_contract.failure_exit: No safe native rollback found.40CF20 is cleanup;40CDD0 cancellation cannot restore source form/status/party/resource state. Do not simply return null from405030 or3D7C70: callers dereference those results.
checkpoint_contract.allocation: Actor/model/weapon creation occurs later and can still fail even after a complete resource check.

next_implementable_work.phase1: Build a pure bounded raw BAR/model/motion parser on owned bytes and an effective asset-source identity. Native3F9850 cannot yet be treated as a side-effect-free staging reader.
next_implementable_work.phase2: Close an explicit transaction around resource staging BEFORE40CE60, or derive a full rollback for every mutated owner. Native cancellation is insufficient.
next_implementable_work.phase3: Validate fresh loaded graph immediately before old actor teardown, bind transition context/source/form/task and compare graph identities. Required hands include main hand and optional secondary; retain normal0..6 semantics.
next_implementable_work.do_not_substitute: Rejecting every cold/not-yet-loaded form would block legitimate first-use locked forms and would not satisfy the requested feature.

test_plan: Malformed root/nested BAR counts, offsets, overflow, link flags and cycles before any native parser call.
MDLX with optional absent type4 follows the proven native branch; typed existing entries require their own bounds.
MSET selected-child/type9/type16 and parent/weapon-joint dependencies validated against bounded content, without invented negative-joint rules.
Registry duplicate names/groups respect first match; moved payload, retired node, zero size, non3 phase and list cycles invalidate snapshots.
Missing file/null completion255 never enters the constructor; demonstrate an owned failure transaction rather than pretending timeout cancels native work.
Rejected stage must make zero form-slot/status/party/Actor writes; every currently valid0..6 target and49 transition pair stays valid.
Repeat plan after initial Revert and after every yield/context/resource change; never reuse original pointers.
Allocation failure remains a separately documented runtime limit unless constructor callers themselves receive a proven error-handling redesign.
